g.text: t0 laptop awake, supervisor submits a work order
t1 DO commits the input, task starts, phase begins
t2 tool phase commits partials (at most every ~100 ms)
t3 task needs time: deadline committed, phase returns
t4 DO hibernates: in-memory state discarded, no invocation held
t5 lid closes: no client attached
t6 alarm fires at the deadline: host calls resume()
t7 task resumes at its checkpoint, next phase runs
t9 laptop wakes, reconnects, reads snapshot, pulls artifacts

text.tspan: Nothing executes between t4 and t6.
Durable sleep preserves state and a deadline, not work.
